chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'When a man embraces Islam, he is circumcised, even if he has reached eighty (years of age).'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: Is circumcision obligatory for adult male converts to Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the obligation of circumcision (khitan) for adult male converts to Islam, emphasizing that it is a condition of complete entry into the fold of Islam regardless of age. By citing the example of a man reaching eighty years, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores that the physical act is not waived due to advanced age or potential difficulty, reflecting the Shia juristic view of its status as a fard (obligatory) act of purification.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When the man becomes a Muslim, he should be circumcised even if he has reached eighty (years)’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ‘If a man becomes a Muslim he must circumcise even if he is eighty years old.’”
